set.body:
Scope: mvpa-fit, mvpa-dataset readers, mvpa-group, mvpa-artifacts, pipeline integration, examples and build.sbt.

Deliverable: Wire functional readouts, dataset readers, group inference and estimates/archive adapters to mvpa4s. Preserve optional dependency boundaries and migrate known external callers.

Acceptance:
- Dataset/fit -> identified evidence -> prediction/RSA and group/archive paths pass as scenario results on JVM/JS.
- ScalaFIM owns fMRI interpretation while reusable MVPA algorithms/types exist only in mvpa4s.
- Old core definitions, imports and temporary aliases are deleted; persisted scientific tags/digests are unchanged unless explicitly migrated.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U4: Migrate ScalaFIM MVPA integrations and delete replaced core
